statement:
The recorded step of adding water to concentrated sulfuric acid is unsafe and incorrect because it can cause violent exothermic boiling and dangerous splattering; acid must always be added to water instead.
The dilution step for procedure PR-6 has been safely executed by adding the acid into water.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded step of adding water to concentrated sulfuric acid is unsafe and incorrect because it can cause violent exothermic boiling" — it names the specific error and gives the correct order.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
